text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: p95 latency above SLO for inference-prod (us-west-2). Alert threshold crossed (90s window).
Alice Chen: I'm on pager. Observed p50 stable but p95 spiking ~2.3x since 10:12 UTC. Customers reporting slow responses and some timeouts.
Ben Patel: Noted. Rolling trace link: https://traces.internal/redwood/trace/af3e... - many spans show long kernel syscalls around 10:11-10:14.
Maya Singh: Can someone grab perf counters on affected hosts? suspecting CPU scheduling or page faults.
Jorge Ruiz: Running perf stat now on node-ukb-37, sending snapshot to /tmp/perf-node-ukb-37.log. Key counters: context-switches++ and minor-faults increased.
Alice Chen: Customer impact: two mid-size customers hit increased tail latencies, ~3% error rate on generation calls. Routing fallback kicked in for high priority customers.
Lina Gomez: Notified CS and Product. Sam, can you confirm which customers saw errors?
Sam Park: Confirmed: AcmeAnalytics and NoteFlow. Both reported timeouts in the 10:12-10:18 window. Providing logs they uploaded to the support ticket.
Ravi Iyer: Looking at model runtime traces — KV cache hit rate dips correspond with the spike window. Could be memory pressure causing swapping or kernel reclaim.
Ben Patel: I see many spans with 'epoll_wait' blocked 50-200ms each. Kernel stack traces attached: 
```
#0 [<c0109f>] schedule+0x5b
#1 [<c0117a>] __schedule+0x2e
#2 [<c0af2b>] io_wait_read+0x1c
```
Suggest we check recent kernel update.
Jorge Ruiz: Confirmed: a rolling kernel patch landed during 10:05-10:08 via auto-image update on a subset of nodes (k8s nodepool gpu-highmem). Patch: 5.15.84 -> 5.15.86 with scheduler tweak.
Maya Singh: Hypothesis A: scheduler change increased runqueue latency causing tail. Hypothesis B: memory reclaim path interacting with our mmaped model weights -> higher minor faults and blocked syscalls.
Alice Chen: Mitigation options: 1) Revert kernel update on affected nodes 2) Cordons + scale new nodes without patch + drain 3) Activate fallback model routing for all impacted customers. Thoughts?
Ben Patel: Quick mitigation: cordon & drain patched nodes and add capacity in unaffected pool. Revert will take longer.
Ravi Iyer: While we do that, enable aggressive KV cache pinning to reduce mmap misses (temporary config toggle).
Lina Gomez: CS: apply fallback routing for AcmeAnalytics and NoteFlow now, notify customers of mitigation.
Sam Park: Done — fallback routing applied at 10:28 UTC. Error rate for NoteFlow dropped to ~0.5% within 2 mins.
Jorge Ruiz: Started cordon/drain of patched pool (node-ukb-31..38). Drains finishing, new nodes coming up with previous kernel.
Maya Singh: Posting perf snapshots and pstack samples in the shared folder: /internal/incidents/4443214321/artifacts.tar.gz. Also uploaded perf counters: minor-faults per-second and context-switch delta charts.
Ben Patel: Attaching trace diff: heavy increase in 'schedule' and 'epoll_wait' durations only on patched nodes. Perf counters show minor-faults ~x4.
Alice Chen: Moving to handoff: I'm going offline in 20. Ben/Maya/Jorge please continue the sleuth. Document timeline and keep thread updated. Lina/Sam continue customer comms and escalate if SLO breach grows.
incident-bot: Incident annotated: mitigation applied (fallback routing), nodes draining, perf data collected. Severity downgraded to P2 at 10:40 UTC pending RCA.
Maya Singh: Quick note for RCA — capture: kernel version, boot logs, full perf stat, pstack, oprofile if possible, and kernel perf events for sched_switch, page_faults.
Ravi Iyer: I'll run a small repro harness on a patched node with synthetic workload to stress mmaped weights and confirm fault path.
Ben Patel: Thanks team. I'll start drafting initial RCA timeline and hypotheses doc and link it here when ready.
Alice Chen: Appreciated. Final note: keep any kernel revert/rollbacks documented in the change log and coordinate with infra to avoid cascading reboots. :white_check_mark:
